sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 720. Success value 100. 4x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Activates Time Slice which reduces the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 70 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Fire, Water, Wind, Light, Dark, Time, and Star elemental attack by 16 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases fire, water, wind, light, dark, time, and star elemental attack buff limit by 6 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Twilight for 120 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Resolute Element (increases all stats by 120%, increases max HP by 120%, and increases status ailment resistance by 30) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 35000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Miracle.
Wind and Light Defense from Unison Damage +600
